selection_amendment.reason: Definition-only conformance review excluded native task 42 because it reveals decisive travel anchors after inventory feedback, and excluded its first replacement, native task 34, because the decisive $200 all-or-nothing budget is likewise first revealed after pricing. Their artifacts are retained but excluded from Phase-A headroom evidence. Native task 41 was selected from its task structure before its Base outcomes were run or inspected.

phase_definition: Structured/Upfront entry: the user's current transaction goals and constraints are available from the beginning; no feedback-triggered hidden intent revision is part of the task.

skill.runtime_semantics: llm_agent with no manual skill injection

tasks.task_structure: One reservation; complete itinerary search; arrival deadline; one full-itinerary flight write; refund bookkeeping.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must compare complete itinerary inventory, preserve route/trip type, calculate a refund and compile all legs into one write.

tasks.task_structure: Round trip; replace return only; compare direct/one-stop inventory; preserve outbound; refund bookkeeping.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The write must reconstruct the full round trip while changing only the return and preserving settlement consistency.

tasks.task_structure: Two-passenger round trip; replace outbound only; nonstop/time/price constraints; preserve return.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must optimize within a time threshold and compile the selected outbound together with the unchanged return for two passengers.

tasks.task_structure: Two-passenger one-way itinerary; compare all one-stop combinations under a layover bound; cabin downgrade and refund.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must derive layover duration from tool times, filter alternatives and correctly calculate a large two-passenger refund.

tasks.task_structure: Three goals stated together: cabin upgrade, full passenger replacement and baggage update on one reservation.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: Three dependent writes must preserve the latest reservation state and all initially stated goals through completion.

tasks.task_structure: One all-or-nothing package: change both directions to constrained nonstop dates, upgrade cabin and add baggage, subject to an upfront $200 package budget.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must price the complete requested package before committing and preserve the user's all-or-nothing boundary when the combined transaction exceeds the stated budget.

tasks.task_structure: Three upfront goals across reservations: assess two cancellations and upgrade a third reservation.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must retain all goals, distinguish two policy-ineligible cancellations from one valid upgrade and complete the valid branch.

tasks.task_structure: Bulk cancellation request over all upcoming reservations; seven reservation reads and per-reservation eligibility classification.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must enumerate the entire reservation set, classify each independently and neither omit eligible cancellations nor mutate ineligible ones.

tasks.task_structure: Rename one passenger in a multi-passenger reservation while preserving the complete passenger roster.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The write API replaces the complete roster, so the unchanged passenger must be carried forward correctly.

tasks.task_structure: Enumerate seven reservations, filter to upcoming single-passenger bookings, and apply cancellation eligibility without mutating ineligible reservations.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must preserve a reservation-to-passenger-count classification, distinguish past from future travel, and avoid executing the user's requested but ineligible cancellations.

tasks.task_structure: Infer conflicting same-day reservations from seven records and preserve the user's known travel anchors and other passengers' bookings.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The target cancellations must be inferred jointly across reservations rather than copied from an explicit reservation list.

tasks.task_structure: Classify five reservations by duration, avoid cancel/upgrade conflicts, price three complete business upgrades and execute the eligible set.
tasks.why_procedurally_non_trivial: The agent must maintain a cross-reservation classification, reconstruct complete itineraries, aggregate cost before confirmation and execute exactly the nonconflicting eligible upgrades.

future_split_constraints.rule: Any reservation/user/state whose trajectories inform later S_A construction must be excluded from Phase B adaptation/evolution and final test.
